messages.name: John Comas Kendall
messages.message: I like smoothies and also cakes

messages.name: Miles Rowland
messages.message:
I WANT MY SMOOTHIE. 

As a weak, sickly, Yorkshire man, the strawberry split in my meal deal is the only vitamins I get. Without this, I will wither away like a leaf at the change of the season. Please, have a little sympathy for the feeble goblins among you. I beg. Please. Do the right thing.

messages.name: Herbie
messages.message: As a student at Churchill, I am proud of our buttery and the delicious, convenient choices available. Unfortunately, from the start of term whilst we still have these options available, but they are no longer available for the same price. We deserve better. It hurts me to think that the incoming freshers wouldn’t understand the beauty of the old meal deal. You may think that it’s a little thing. But it’s not. We remember

messages.name: William Krohn
messages.message: I felt embarrassed coming back this year and being faced with such a worse meal deal. Please do better!

messages.name: josh james tindall
messages.message: i’m fat and i like to eat more food for the meal deal

messages.name: Moses Yu
messages.message: I'm a big eater. I want more food. Yum yum

messages.name: JD
messages.message: Without the extra options, the meal deal is not worth it anymore :(

messages.name: William Le
messages.message: I'm going on an obligatory hunger strike until Churchill Meal Deal restores to uts former glory

messages.name: Gordon Yeo Chong Jin
messages.message: Food is my second biggest passion in life

messages.name: Anonymous
messages.message: It pains me to hear colleagues from other colleges brag about their cheap and great-value meal deals

messages.name: Anonymous
messages.message: I want the barista drinks and cakes back in the meal deal. This isn't a meal deal anymore it's just a bad deal.

messages.name: Agastya Kumar
messages.message: It’s absolutely critical that all students at Churchill have a viable, affordable option and alternative to dining hall food so that in times of inconvenience and struggle there is a assuring, nourishing and fulfilling meal waiting for us.

messages.name: Tristan Jenkins
messages.message: Not student friendly prices anymore! Worse that a supermarket meal deal now

messages.name: Frank
messages.message: It’s getting a bit ridiculous with how much is getting removed.

messages.name: Daisy Webb
messages.message: This change is fundamentally anti-student. How can you call it a ‘Meal-Deal’ if it’s not a good deal?

messages.name: Malcolm
messages.message: Please bring back the old meal deal. Between this and the electricity price changes, I don't want to give any extra money to the college.... will be buying my own food and boycotting the buttery.

messages.name: Amalia Blank
messages.message: I get that their prices have increased, but they need to at least provide a ‘premium’ meal deal option.
